OwnerRegistration.title: OwnerRegistration
OwnerRegistration.description: Verified owner access record created when entering the valid owner code 100214.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

LicenseAccount.title: LicenseAccount
LicenseAccount.description: Cross-device LVNG SPACE user license account managed by Owner and bound exclusively to the first login device.

passwordHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the account password.

createdByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the Owner who created this account.

durationDays.description: Number of valid days (-1 for LIFETIME, 1..3650 for timed accounts).

expiresAtMillis.description: UTC expiration epoch milliseconds (-1 for LIFETIME).

boundDeviceId.description: Unique device installation ID locked on first successful login (empty before first login).

boundDeviceName.description: Readable device model name for the locked device.

boundByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who claimed the device lock (empty before first login).

/owners/{ownerUid}.description: Stores verified owner registrations gated by ownerCode 100214.

/accounts/{accountId}.description: Stores cross-device LVNG SPACE accounts indexed by normalized lowercase username.
